headline: Committee continues South Maui Community Plan review, deletes action 2.32

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.summary: The committee continued reviewing Bill 108, approving tree-care training workshops and a park study, and deleting action 2.32 as similar to action 2.24. The chair said the goal is to get as far as possible by October 8.
meeting.recap: The committee met to continue reviewing Bill 108, the South Maui Community Plan.[[0:14:49]] Spoken testimony closed September 21, 2026; written testimony is still accepted.[[0:15:00]] The chair said the goal is to get as far as possible by October 8.[[0:17:38]] The chair said passing the plan this term is possible but unlikely at this pace.[[0:19:18]] The chair said at least five members liked the process, so the review would continue.[[0:46:50]] The committee approved yearly tree-care training workshops in South Maui for landscapers and arborists.[[1:15:21]] Members agreed to cite the Lahaina Community Land Trust as an example in an action giving housing preference to long-term Maui residents.[[1:30:34]] Members made the South Maui affordable housing program action ongoing and subject to available funds.[[2:25:23]] Planning said it does not need more staff to enforce rules on illegal short-term rentals.[[2:35:08]] Members deleted action 2.32 because it was nearly the same as the housing preference action.[[2:47:23]] Members voted to study expanding a park for low-key 'passive park' uses and set its priority to medium.[[2:52:46]]
decided: Members approved working with the South Maui hospitality industry on green initiatives to limit waste and water use and reduce carbon footprint.
Members approved adding OED as a lead agency and naming South Maui hotels in the visitor transportation action.
Members approved deleting action 2.32 because it is substantially similar to action 2.24.
meeting.next: Planning will ask enforcement staff for a three-year trend of illegal short-term rental numbers. Staff were asked to add OED to the plan's list of acronyms. The chair will consider during lunch a possible revisit of a sea level rise action for South Kīhei Road.

moments.q: Chair reads an absent member's texted statement on the process
"I did hear a minimum of five members liked the process"
"we do not require additional staff to do illegal short-term rental enforcement at this time"
